这份快照中最顶层调用链覆盖的采样次数。它反映采样规模，不等于实际内存字节。: The number of samples covered by the top-level call chain in this snapshot. It indicates sampling scale, not actual memory bytes.
当前快照实际出现的最大调用层级。层级越深只表示调用链更长，不直接代表问题严重程度: The deepest call level present in this snapshot. A deeper stack only means a longer call chain; it does not by itself indicate severity.
从当前已审核快照中解析出的调用帧数量。它用于衡量火焰图的细节规模，不是对象或线程: The number of call frames parsed from this reviewed snapshot. It measures flame-graph detail, not objects or threads.
比例相对根样本数，不代表内存字节；父子帧不可相加。: Percentages are relative to root samples, not memory bytes; parent and child frames must not be added together.
同一 FE 的两份采样快照: Two sampled snapshots from the same FE
仅在两份快照各自前 32 个热点候选中比较覆盖率百分点；不代表内存字节、独占内存: Coverage percentage points are compared only among the top 32 hotspot candidates in each snapshot. They do not represent memory bytes, exclusive memory, or a call chain disappearing.
两次快照的根样本量可以不同；变化只按覆盖率百分点比较，不能据此推断内存字节变化。: The root sample counts can differ. Changes compare coverage percentage points only and cannot be used to infer changes in memory bytes.
